Career Journey

Senior Capital Program Manager at King County, Washington. His work converts waste into renewable energy, reclaims water and produces organic fertiliser.

At my workplace, King County’s Wastewater Treatment Division, we treat wastewater to produce several valuable by-products, including reclaimed water for irrigation, electricity generated from biogas through waste-to-energy processes, and organic fertilizer
